## prompt-4-final-protocol

*Generated by Process A from the master prompt in
[`../prompts/prompt-protocol.md`](../prompts/prompt-protocol.md), adapting the
Phase I `trial-protocol` final stage and the author corrections visible across the
Phase I cycle to the Phase II protocol. Runs in stage
`trial-phase-2/final-protocol/`, then produces `final-protocol/publication/` (the
paper URL directory) with author edits.*

Produce the polished, **final** Phase II protocol LaTeX and zip into
`trial-phase-2/final-protocol/`, so its context and formatting quality match and
exceed `trial-phase-2/full-protocol/`, then create
`trial-phase-2/final-protocol/publication/` as the author-edited paper URL
directory.

**Maximum-quality pass.** Double-verify all context and formatting. Re-examine
every TikZ figure for text-box and arrow overlaps, correct curved-arrow
looseness, and box spacing. Implement the author's `\clearpage` per NIH section,
`\raggedbottom`, table-column-width, `\vspace`, and `\hspace` methods and the
author's other proof-reading techniques so each section and page is self-standing,
with no overcrowding and no large empty white spaces. Avoid single or two-word
lines and any single line stranded on the next page. Tune the bibliography
appearance with ragged-right so no line ends with a single stranded word. Verify
single hyphens only, the section symbol for every codified reference (21 CFR
312.x, 812.x), and that every figure carried from the Mermaid catalog reads with
the same complexity. Include the PNG-free TikZ ORCID iD mark and the DOI
`10.5281/zenodo.xxxxxxxx`
([https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.xxxxxxxx](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.xxxxxxxx)),
version v1.1.0, June 23, 2026.

**Internal consistency to confirm.** The sample size (n = 220, 110 per arm), the
hazard ratio (0.60), the power (85 percent), the event count (about 140), the
RP2D (300 mg once daily), the eight sites, the upgraded Phase 0 gate (USL greater
than or equal to 8.0, at least 5000 sims, at least 3 frameworks, less than 1.5 mm
and less than 0.4 N), the hard caps (3 N per arm, 18 N cumulative, 3 ms cross-arm
E-stop), the vessel thresholds, and the advisory windows must be identical across
every section, figure, and table.

**Content.** Carry the complete Phase II protocol in its improved final form:
every NIH section; the multicenter randomized controlled design; the two arms; the
confirmatory PFS primary and the key secondary hierarchy; the four counterfactual
scenarios; the nine Physical AI concerns and mitigations; the Patient-Aligned
Co-Investment Facility and the capital firewall; the full safety, statistical,
and oversight machinery; and the back matter. No images; white background;
Burgundy `#800020` document color.

**Files and commit schedule.** One commit each for `main.tex`, `protostyle.sty`,
`references.bib`, and `README.md`; one commit per `sections/*.tex`. File
`prompt-final-protocol.md` (this prompt verbatim) and `output-final-protocol.md`.
Then build `final-protocol/publication/` (main.tex, protostyle.sty,
references.bib, sections, README, and the Overleaf zip) as the author-edited paper
URL directory. Push every commit in real time (10+ commits). The second-to-last
commit fixes all errors; the last commit performs the remaining repository
updates: the v4.1.0 entries in root `CHANGELOG.md` and `releases.md`, the root
`README.md` updates (2x badges, ASCII diagrams, table of contents, repository
structure, a new version section, protocol tables and colored Mermaid), the
`final-protocol/README.md`, the `final-protocol-LaTeX.zip`, and
`../prompts/output-protocol.md`. Do not stall, ask questions, or go into plan
mode. The LaTeX must compile in Overleaf with pdfLaTeX.
